title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE omits pending byte counts for OPERATION and UNSET fds
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info exposes bytes_written and bytes_read but not the pending bytes available in the internal buffers. For OPERATION fds, outbuf_len - outbuf_drained (bytes available to read right now) is missing. For UNSET fds, inbuf_len (bytes written but not yet consumed by KEY_IMPORT) is absent — a debugger cannot diagnose 'why did KEY_IMPORT return -EINVAL' (insufficient inbuf data) from GET_STATE alone. These fields cannot be added later without an ABI-breaking struct resize.
close_reason: fixed: added __u64 outbuf_pending and inbuf_pending to crypto2dev_fd_state_info (168B total); populated in both OPERATION and KEY branches of ioctl_get_state
